name: Sifency Addons
author: Sifency

sections.description:
Sifency Addons is a powerful and intuitive plugin that extends Elementor with a huge library of unique and highly customizable widgets. Whether you are building a standard business website, a creative portfolio, a blog, or a full-featured WooCommerce store, Sifency Addons provides the tools you need to create stunning, professional designs without touching a single line of code.

Our widget collection is thoughtfully organized into categories for general content creation, dynamic theme building, and an extensive suite of WooCommerce widgets to perfect your online store. Every widget is built with performance and flexibility in mind, offering deep styling controls directly within the Elementor editor.

Unlock the full potential, or use it with any theme, to build faster and design better.

Features

Our extensive library of 90+ widgets includes:

General Content Widgets
* Title & Headings
* Advanced Image
* Advanced Button
* Icon List
* Icon Box
* Social Share
* Blockquote
* Fun Fact (Counter)
* Nested Slider
* Progress Bar
* Circle Text (Animated)
* Accordion / FAQ
* Marquee (Scrolling Text)
* Social Icons
* Elementor Template shortcode
* Contact Form Styler
* Mailchimp Form Styler

Dynamic & Theme Builder Widgets (Elementor Pro Recommended)
* Post Navigation (Next/Previous)
* Post Title
* Featured Image (Post Media)
* Post Meta Data (Author, Date, etc.)
* Post Terms (Categories & Tags)
* Author Box
* Post Comments
* Post Excerpt
* Post Content
* Site Logo
* Search Form

Powerful Post & CPT Grids
* Awards
* Blog Post Grid & Sliders
* Career / Job Listings
* Clients & Logos
* Events
* Projects / Portfolio
* Services
* Team Members
* Testimonials

Extensive WooCommerce Integration (WooCommerce Required)
* Products Grid
* Products Slider
* Related Products
* Single Product Image
* Product Breadcrumb
* Product Price
* Mini Cart
* Custom Add to Cart Button
* Product Short Description
* Product Meta (SKU, Categories)
* Product Stock Status
* Product Rating
* Full Checkout Page Styler
* Wishlist Button & Counter (YITH Wishlist integration)
* Product Description Tab
* Product Additional Info Tab
* Product Reviews Tab

Requirements

To get the most out of Sifency Addons, please ensure you have the following installed and activated:

  • WordPress: Version 5.5 or higher
  • PHP: Version 7.4 or higher
  • Elementor: (Required) The free version of Elementor is required for all widgets.
  • WooCommerce: (Required for E-commerce) Required for the entire suite of product, cart, and checkout widgets to be available.
  • YITH WooCommerce Wishlist: (Optional) Required only for the “Wishlist” widget to function.

External Services

This plugin uses third-party services to enable content sharing functionality. These services are only used when a user actively clicks on a share button. No personal data is collected or stored by the plugin itself.

  • Service: Facebook

    • Purpose: Allows users to share content on their Facebook timeline.
    • Data Sent: The URL of the page being shared is sent to Facebook when a user clicks the share button.
    • Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/policy.php

  • Service: Twitter (X)

    • Purpose: Allows users to share content as a post on their Twitter (X) feed.
    • Data Sent: The URL and title of the page being shared are sent to Twitter when a user clicks the share button.
    • Terms of Service: https://twitter.com/en/tos
    • Privacy Policy: https://twitter.com/en/privacy

  • Service: LinkedIn

    • Purpose: Allows users to share content on their LinkedIn profile.
    • Data Sent: The URL of the page being shared is sent to LinkedIn when a user clicks the share button.
    • Terms of Service: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy

  • Service: Pinterest

    • Purpose: Allows users to pin content on their Pinterest boards.
    • Data Sent: The URL of the page being shared is sent to Pinterest when a user clicks the share button.
    • Terms of Service: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/terms-of-service
    • Privacy Policy: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/privacy-policy

  • Service: WhatsApp

    • Purpose: Allows users to share content via the WhatsApp application.
    • Data Sent: The URL and title of the page being shared are sent to WhatsApp’s API when a user clicks the share button.
    • Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

  • Service: AOS (Animate On Scroll Library)

    • Purpose: Provides scroll-based animation effects in frontend widgets.
    • Data Sent: No personal data is sent. The script is downloaded from a CDN when the page loads.
    • Terms of Service: https://www.jsdelivr.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.jsdelivr.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin:
    • Navigate to your WordPress admin panel.
    • Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Upload the sifency-addons.zip file and click Install Now.
  2. Activate the Plugin:
    • After installation, click Activate Plugin to enable Sifency Addons.
  3. Verify Requirements:
    • Ensure you have the required plugins (like Elementor) installed and activated for the widgets to appear.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

Many of our general content widgets work perfectly with the free version of Elementor. However, to use the dynamic and theme-building widgets (like Post Title, Featured Image, Author Box, and WooCommerce single product page elements), you will need Elementor Pro.

The WooCommerce widgets are not appearing in the editor. Why?

The WooCommerce widgets will only be registered and appear in the Elementor widget panel if you have the WooCommerce plugin installed and activated on your website.

Can I use this plugin with any theme?

Yes! While designed to work perfectly with Sifency themes, Sifency Addons is compatible with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor.

How do I customize the style of the widgets?

Every widget comes with a comprehensive set of styling options located in the “Style” tab of the Elementor editor. You can control colors, typography, spacing, borders, and much more.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of Sifency Addons.
  • Added 55+ widgets for general content, theme building, and WooCommerce.
  • Integrated with Elementor’s styling and control APIs.
